caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional statue of a standing figure, likely representing a Native American man, positioned centrally on a plinth with multiple tiers. The figure is shown in profile, facing to the right, with long black hair adorned with a yellow headband and two upright feathers, one red and one white. The clothing consists of a red tunic with green and yellow trim, a blue-green necklace, and a belt with white fringe or feathered detail around the waist. The lower half includes brown leggings and black moccasins. The figure's right hand is holding what appears to be a bundle of cigars against the chest, and the left hand is resting on the hip, holding a large brown object that may resemble a pouch or bag. Surrounding the central colored illustration are two schematic line drawings at the bottom corners of the page; one on the left shows the statue from the front, and the one on the right shows the statue from the rear. The background is a plain, lightly yellowed paper enclosed within a thin rectangular border. The artist’s and contributor’s names, "Gordon K. Saltar" and "Samuel Anderson, Artist," appear at the bottom of the page. The drawing is rendered in colored pencil or watercolor and ink.
title: Cigar Store Indian
